supersede.why: scripts/supersede_check.py --parts track=none,catalog=none,evaluate=none,integrate=none is not a candidate. Harness2 tunes one agent harness from task runs. It does not watch outside sources, it does not keep a deduped tool catalog with stage cards, and it does not score catalog tools on I0-I4. The local sandbox under examples/harness2-local is this repo's trial of that pin, not harness2 wiring outside tools in with a run on main. A bench score is not suite coverage. Do not adopt it in place of this repo. Do not add a watchlist row.
